grimsby.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of North East Lincolnshire
s1loc: Grimsby anchors the events trade of North East Lincolnshire. The Grimsby Auditorium is the area's leading venue for touring shows, concerts, comedy and pantomime, Yardbirds Rock Club keeps a grassroots live-music room running, and just over the boundary the Meridian Showground at Cleethorpes hosts The Gathering Festival across a summer Saturday. Add civic events and seasonal shows along the wider Humber bank and the crew, stage and front-of-house work fills the calendar through the warmer months.

And the trade runs at every size. The bigger venues, festival operators and production companies field large seasonal teams and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers around Grimsby and across to Scunthorpe and Hull want only a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier here has to serve the festival on the showground and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts for managed reordering and direct online ordering side by side.

Grimsby builds its events around the auditorium and its parks. The Grimsby Auditorium takes the touring concerts and shows, People's Park and the town centre host community days and seasonal festivals, and the historic fishing docks and the Fishing Heritage Centre bring heritage events to the waterfront. With Cleethorpes and its big summer calendar right next door, the area keeps production and front-of-house crews busy across the season.
